findings.text: Creation reserves a host page for the primary control block, initializes confidential guest and interrupt virtualization state, reserves the MSR permission bitmap, marks extended interrupt and branch sampling state as trapped, maps and selects the primary block, and leaves guest state marked unloaded for lazy load on entry, releasing reservations in reverse order on failure.
Destruction expects no queued interrupt remainders, exits and releases nested state, releases confidential state, then releases the primary control block page and the MSR permission bitmap.

Reset clears both speculation control shadows and rebuilds the control block through the shared initializer, with additional OS workaround, microcode, timing ratio, and NMI state refresh only outside INIT events.
Traps for INVPCID and RDTSCP and RDPMC stay enabled unless host capability plus guest capability plus paging mode together allow passthrough, with counter policy delegated to a shared helper.

When SVME is clear in guest state, traps for VMLOAD and VMSAVE and CLGI and STGI stay set; when set, load save behavior follows guest vendor compatibility and virtual load save support, while interrupt flag behavior follows virtual GIF support and reevaluates pending masked events through an event request.
Overall intercept refresh composes instruction policy refresh with MSR policy refresh.

Initialization installs default traps for control register reads and writes, debug registers, selected faults, external and nonmaskable interrupts, selective emulation, identification, cache and TLB maintenance, I/O and MSR protection, task switching, shutdown, nested operations, and power and debug extensions, with conditional traps for VMware backdoor faults, system management interrupts, monitor wait, halt variants, pause, and bus lock.

Initialization programs permission bitmap bases and interrupt masking, establishes default segment and descriptor table images, applies nested paging adjustments that clear page fault and control register traps and seed paging metadata, applies optional encryption and tagging and interrupt and Hyper-V and confidential extensions, resets address space identifiers and nested addresses, requests intercept refresh, marks the block fully dirty, and enables global interrupts.

Control state holds permission bitmap addresses, interrupt control and vector and priority, miscellaneous enables, pause filter parameters, and address space identity, while save state holds segment images, descriptor table bases and limits, flags, control registers, and paging metadata, with dirty tracking per field group.
Queries for CS and SS and DS and ES read the current image, while queries for FS and GS and TR and LDTR read the primary image; unknown selectors are fatal.

Generic segment output decodes type, system, privilege, presence, availability, long, and default size fields from the hardware attribute word, derives granularity from limit size and usability from presence, forces busy type for task state and accessed indication for usable data, clears default size for unusable stack, and sources stack privilege from saved privilege level.
A per virtual CPU loaded marker gates host save and timing and mitigation setup on entry and is cleared when returning to host, so entry work runs once per residency.
During NMI single step, flag reads hide trap and resume indicators unless the guest had set them, while flag writes force both indicators on.

A global guest count tracks active virtual machines for branch mitigation, with first creation and last destruction serialized, last destruction broadcasting a per CPU clear, and entry lazily setting a per CPU marker once; builds without the feature use empty init and destroy operations.

A dedicated spinlock protects transitions that create the first guest and destroy the last guest, paired with atomic count manipulation and a recheck under lock before broadcasting clears, preventing a delayed clear from racing a new guest.

Load shrinks the pause exiting window after descheduling when pause causes exits and loads interrupt virtualization when active; put releases interrupt virtualization, clears the loaded marker, and counts a host reload.
Register caching explicitly marks availability and supports only page directory pointer reload from the guest control register when nested paging is active, treating other registers as fatal.

Window requests for virtual interrupts arm a dummy trap with zero vector, highest priority, and masking, marked dirty for hardware, but are ignored when interrupt virtualization is active or when a concurrent refresh already cleared the trap.

Table accessors exchange size and address between generic descriptors and save area images with descriptor dirty marking; control register zero and four checks always accept; control register three write through to the save area with dirty marking happens only for encrypted state guests.

Enlightenment setup has an active form that enables nested flush and bitmap features when host nested capabilities and paging mode allow, with a compile time overlay size check, and an empty form that does nothing.

Entry unmaps GHCB state when present, saves host state through a fault tolerant store, prepares encrypted guest host state when needed, writes the TSC multiplier when scaling is enabled, and installs TSC AUX through user return handling unless hardware virtualizes it for encrypted guests.

Unknown segment selectors, unsupported cached registers, window use under active interrupt virtualization, and teardown with queued interrupts trigger traps or warnings, while host save faults are contained as spurious faults.
Quirked reset uses microcode version 0x01000065.

Initial code image uses selector 0xf000 with base 0xffff0000 and limit 0xffff and readable present system code attributes; descriptor tables use base 0 with limit 0xffff; system segments use LDT and busy 16 bit TSS types.
Dummy virtual interrupt uses vector 0 with priority 0xf.
When general protection faults are not trapped, hardware might deliver such a fault before management instruction traps are evaluated, inverting guest visible precedence.
Without confidential support, virtual CPU creation reports success immediately and release performs no work.
Host save executes a single operand virtualization store guarded by a fault table that redirects failures to spurious fault handling and returns normally on success.
Reset always zeroes both speculation control shadows regardless of event type.
Flag writes do not update privilege level explicitly because virtual 8086 changes are always accompanied by stack reload.
